items.title: ❗️President Zelenskyy said Ukraine is ready for an energy truce: a halt to strikes on energy infrastructure. At the same time, he stressed the difference in approaches: for Putin, energy means selling oil and gas; for Ukraine, it means light for people. Commenting on the Russian strike on a train near the Polish border that carried U.S. and European representatives, Zelenskyy said the Russians may not have known Americans were on board — or they may have known. He does not trust them and believes they knew.

items.title: ❗️Ukraine’s Defense Ministry has codified and approved for service with the Armed Forces the Skazhenyi interceptor drone with a terminal-guidance system, UV Military Cluster told Militarnyi. The lineup includes seven variants — day, night, with terminal guidance, analog and digital video — each supplied with the matching equipment set. Stated specifications: speed up to 340 km/h, altitude up to 7,000 m, flight time up to 15 minutes, payload 500 g. The terminal-guidance system has been tested, and the first aircraft have already been delivered to positions in Odesa and Zaporizhzhia regions; the product is not intended for intercepting jet-powered drones. Source: Militarnyi.

items.title: ❗️Poland has begun building fortifications on its border with Ukraine to protect against Russian air strikes. The decision was made after Russian attacks on Ukrainian border checkpoints and a train 2 km from the Polish border. Engineering units are already reinforcing checkpoints and infrastructure near the crossings at Dorohusk, Medyka and Korczowa: they are installing collapsible containers lined with mesh and filled with sand or gravel, which will serve as blast-protection walls, and setting up observation and guard posts. This was reported by Reuters.

items.title: ❗️The Netherlands plans to allocate over €3 billion in military aid to Ukraine in 2027. This was announced by the country’s Ministry of Defence during the presentation of the defence budget. Priorities will include repair of already transferred equipment, unmanned systems and air defence. The ministry stressed that amid intensifying Russian attacks such support remains critically important.

items.title: ❗️Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy met in Kyiv with Eisuke Mori, Speaker of the House of Representatives of the Japanese Parliament. The sides discussed energy support for Ukraine ahead of winter and defense cooperation, including possible Japanese participation in the PURL program. Zelenskyy emphasized that the Japanese delegation’s visit to Kyiv amid ongoing Russian attacks is an important demonstration of support.

items.title: ❗️Russian strategic bombers Tu-95MS armed with Kh-101 cruise missiles carried out a five-hour flight over the Barents and Norwegian Seas north of Scandinavia, escorted by Su-33 fighters. NATO responded by scrambling its own fighters to escort them. Unlike typical training flights, the aircraft were armed with missiles this time.

items.title: ❗️Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said during a visit to Azerbaijan that over the past year the Russia-Ukraine war has turned from a war of attrition into a war of destruction. According to him, almost no targets remain that have not come under attack, and civilian casualties continue to rise. Fidan warned that the scale of escalation will only grow and called for the war to be stopped as soon as possible to prevent it from spreading and causing further disasters.

items.title: Nothing of that statement is true. The oil prices exploded only because of the failed war in Iran and escalated even more with the war in Yemen. Saudi Arabia is cut off from both sides, the Strait of Hornuz and the Red Sea, while losing its East-West Pipeline. The fact that Trump is trying to pin his failure on Ukraine should serve as a warning to all of us that the White House has lost the ability to control the situation and preemptively starts the blame game. We have a saying in Germany: „Lies have short legs.“ It means that lying won’t get you far. The truth will catch up and punish you even more. Trump has given Iran cover and incentive to escalate even more. With that statement Tehran has all reasons to strike even harder, given that Trump falsely blames Ukraine. The oil price will increase even more.

items.title: The Russian salient north of Lyman, Donetsk region, Ukraine has collapsed. Ukrainian forces are moving into this area, conducting mopping up operations. It is only a matter of time until all Russian units in that former salient have been dislodged or neutralized. Basically the entire Russian invasion force west of the Zherebets' River in this sector is currently in utter disarray. It took Russian more than a year and countless losses to even establish that salient. The Russian propaganda announced Lyman's fall already. Seeing the collapse in a matter of weeks only paraphrases the absolute insanity of the Russia tactics to mindlessly throw in bodies with virtually zero gain and now even a territorial loss. Far worse for the Russian invasion is the setback on the operational level. Their movements have already been minuscule. Lyman is vital if Russians want to move forward. Even according the most optimistic prognostications for the Russian side, it would have taken years for them to take the Ukrainian fortress cities Kramatorsk and Sloviansk, if at all. This setback, however, not only wasted a tremendous amount of Russian resources and troops, but also pushed the target even further away. It marks now the official failure of Russian summer offensive.

items.title: The amount of Patriot interceptor missiles the US are using to counter Iranian attacks is mind-boggling. Between 60 and 100 missiles, possibly even more, fired in a matter of minutes, the majority being PAC-3 MSE interceptors. It is obvious that Iran is deliberately exhausting US stockpiles using rather cheap missiles. The political backlash in the US is already huge, and any further uncoordinated escalation is primarily hurting the US and the West altogether. The Iranian regime has also nothing seriously to fear from the Trump administration, because of the wasted time in the beginning of the year. Only a full-scale invasion would change their calculus, but of course, there is virtually a zero chance that this is going to happen. Hence, they are feeling emboldened. The White House is even not capable to grasp or admit that Tehran is clearly coordinating with Russia. The coordination is certainly going beyond providing target coordinates of US troops. Not to mention the surging oil price which helps them both. The only good news is that Ukraine is depleting Russia, and by extension Iran. But Washington is clearly squandering that momentum. Without any serious grand strategy by the US administration, which would also consider the inclusion of allies and partners, this whole war is a blunder of epic proportions. It is only the latest example how important a clear strategy, solid alliances and trust are.
